description: This file contains the implementation of the WSEndpoint class template for WebSocket endpoint management, including connection handling, message processing, threading, and role-based configuration, within a WebSocket-based communication library.

classes.name: WSEndpoint
classes.description: A highly templated WebSocket endpoint class that manages WebSocket connections, message handling, threading, and applies role-based and encryption configurations for real-time communication.

methods.name: WSEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor that initializes WebSocket endpoint, sets access/error channels, registers event handlers, initializes ASIO, and sets up encryption.

methods.name: ~WSEndpoint
methods.description: Destructor that stops the event loop, closes any open connections, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: closeConnection
methods.description: Closes the current WebSocket connection if it is open.

methods.name: startEventLoop
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket event processing loop in a new thread.

methods.name: stopEventLoop
methods.description: Joins the event loop thread to stop the WebSocket processing.

methods.name: registerHandlers
methods.description: Binds WebSocket event handlers for message receipt, connection open, close, and failure events.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over the WebSocket connection if it is valid and open.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages and passes payloads to the messaging interface if the opcode matches.

methods.name: onOpen
methods.description: Handles new WebSocket connection establishment, starts pinging, and signals successful initialization.

methods.name: onFail
methods.description: Handles connection failure, logs error details, and updates connection state.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Handles WebSocket connection closure and triggers cleanup or notification procedures.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the connection object from a connection handler.
